## History

Phillips served as the teacher at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, having secured his position because his uncle was a school trustee. During his tenure, he administered punishments to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), including making her stand at the blackboard after she smashed a slate over Gilbert Blythe's head and later forcing her to sit next to Gilbert. At the end of the school term, Mr. Phillips delivered a farewell speech to his students as he departed from the school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phillips.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as Anne's schoolteacher, though his heavy-handed discipline creates significant conflict between them. He singles her out for public punishment, such as forcing her to stand at the blackboard after she breaks a slate over Gilbert's head, and later humiliates her by making her sit next to Gilbert. These humiliating punishments deeply upset [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), driving her to temporarily abandon attending school altogether before eventually returning to focus on her studies.

- Commands — teacher of Anne  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P24](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0024)</sub>

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips acts as a mentor to Prissy, one of his older students at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. In addition to supervising her academic work, he engages in a romantic courtship with her. His personal attention toward Prissy unfolds alongside his regular duties as the local schoolmaster.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>
- Romantically involved with — courting her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>
